To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks — small ask about attendee bundles and routing

Hey Jonas,

Great webinar earlier — really appreciated the demo of the private deployment flow. Two quick asks from my team:

1) Can you send a short attendee roster with titles so our AMs can prioritize outreach?
2) We loved the idea of a replay 'concierge kit' — can we request a version that maps clips to quick use-case callouts for our internal sales?

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 17:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks — small ask about attendee bundles and routing

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for joining! Attendee roster attached (CSV). I put together a lightweight "concierge replay kit" bundle that pairs 3 short clips (intro, deployment walkthrough, SLA/cost primer) with one-line callout bullets for SDRs. Attachment: convexa_concierge_replay_kit_v1.zip.

Routing plan proposal:
- Tag attendees with two fields: company_size (">500", "100-500", "<100") and intent_signal ("technical", "procurement", "product") based on poll + Q&A + LinkedIn enrichment.
- Auto-route any attendee with company_size ">500" AND intent_signal "technical" to the "Field - Technical SDR (West)" queue.
- Mark attendees with high intent but <100 as "Concierge nurture" and route to Marissa for a personalized outreach.

Marissa/Naomi — can you confirm SDR coverage for these queues next week and whether we prefer to consume the hubspot list via the HS-Record or push a CSV?

Jonas Weber
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
